title: The Lion and the Mouse
description: A tiny promise seems impossible until a trapped lion discovers that help can come in every size.
catalogueBlurb: A tiny mouse makes a huge promise, then proves that even the smallest friend can make a big difference.
author: Aesop, retold by Quill

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on Aesop's public-domain fable
text.notes: The underlying fable is public domain; this wording is an original Unicorn Valley retelling.
